zh.title: 屏東攜手長榮航空邀德國旅遊業者踩線 為拓展歐洲市場鋪路
zh.summary: 屏東縣府與長榮航空邀德國旅遊業者踩線，為拓展歐洲市場鋪路
body: 屏東縣政府與長榮航空邀請德國慕尼黑的戶外運動及特色旅遊業者到屏東踩線，體驗當地多元遊程。縣府表示，此行為未來拓展歐洲市場奠定基礎。
踩線團透過六天五夜的實地走訪，行程涵蓋山林探索、生態賞鳥、海洋運動及原住民族等內容。縣府表示，走訪讓業者親身感受屏東的自然景觀與戶外活動。屏東縣府並稱，此次與長榮航空合作串聯國際航線及地方觀光資源，透過實地踩線與在地交流，促進屏東特色景點、專業導覽及戶外活動轉化為符合歐洲市場需求的旅遊商品。

en.title: Pingtung and EVA Air Host German Tourism Operators to Lay Groundwork for European-Market Growth
en.summary: Pingtung County Government and EVA Air host German tourism operators on a scouting visit for European-market expansion.
body: Pingtung County Government and EVA Air invited outdoor-sports and specialty-tourism operators from Munich, Germany, to visit Pingtung and sample local itineraries. The county said the trip would lay groundwork for future expansion in the European market.

The six-day, five-night visit included mountain exploration, ecological birdwatching, marine sports and Indigenous cultural experiences. The county said the trip gave the operators first-hand exposure to Pingtung’s natural scenery and outdoor activities. Pingtung County Government said its work with EVA Air links international routes with local tourism resources. The county said site visits and local exchanges are intended to help turn Pingtung’s attractions, professional guided tours and outdoor activities into travel products suited to European demand.

zh.title: 波音10月交付49架 737 MAX交付量降至32架
zh.summary: 波音10月交付49架，較9月減少；737 MAX交付32架，較9月減少
body: 根據AeroTime，波音2026年10月交付49架飛機，低於9月的57架。這是波音全公司的月交付總量，不是單一機型的數字。各機型另有分項交付數，737 MAX的數字包含在全公司總量中，兩者代表不同層級的統計。
737 MAX在10月交付32架，低於9月的43架。Aerospace Global News報導，波音10月交付的其他型號包括11架787 Dreamliners、兩架777 Freighters及三架767s。這些型號數字是各自的交付分項，與49架的全公司總交付量並列，並非另一個整體交付總數。
2026年還剩兩個月時，波音年內已交付524架飛機。2025年同期，波音已交付493架；到2025年年底，全年交付總數為600架。524架與493架是相同年度進度點的年初至今累計交付量，600架則涵蓋2025全年，與前兩項數字的時間範圍不同。2026年的524架也是截至當時的年度累計數，並非2026全年總數。
訂單是另一項10月統計。Aerospace Global News報導，當月記錄165筆訂單，其中140架為Avolon訂購的波音737 MAX，並佔當月新增業務的大部分。訂單數不等同於已交付架數：165筆是10月記錄的訂單，49架則是當月交付的飛機總數。兩者分別反映新訂單與已完成交付，不能合併為同一項交付統計。

en.title: Boeing October deliveries fall to 49; 737 MAX handovers drop to 32
en.summary: Boeing delivered 49 aircraft in October; 737 MAX deliveries fell to 32 from 43.
body: According to AeroTime, Boeing delivered 49 aircraft in October 2026, down from 57 in September. The figure is the company’s total for the month, while individual aircraft-family numbers describe only part of the delivery picture. The 737 MAX figure is one model-specific component of the 49-aircraft total. The comparison between September and October therefore concerns two consecutive all-aircraft monthly totals.

The 737 MAX delivery count was 32 aircraft in October, compared with 43 in September. Boeing’s other reported October deliveries included 11 787 Dreamliners, two 777 Freighters and three 767s. These figures identify reported counts for several aircraft types, without changing the company-wide total of 49. The individual type counts are part of the month’s delivery data, not an alternative total.

With two months remaining in 2026, Boeing had delivered 524 aircraft so far this year. At the equivalent point in 2025, it had delivered 493; by the end of 2025, the total was 600. The 524 and 493 figures compare deliveries at matching year-to-date points, while 600 is a full-year total. The figures cover different periods: 600 spans all of 2025, whereas 524 is the 2026 year-to-date count.

Orders were another figure reported for October. Aerospace Global News said 165 orders were recorded during the month, of which 140 were Boeing 737 MAX aircraft ordered by Avolon, accounting for most of October’s new business. That 165-order tally is separate from the 49 deliveries: one counts orders and the other counts aircraft already delivered. Treating them as distinct keeps a new order separate from a completed handover.

zh.title: 航空短訊彙整：美聯航華盛頓杜勒斯機場（IAD）E航廈啟用，首期設14個登機門；澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線
zh.summary: 本期收錄3則獨立消息：美聯航華盛頓杜勒斯機場E航廈啟用，首期設14個登機門、澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線、漢莎航空接收首架A350-1000，同時為漢莎集團第700架空中巴士飛機。
body: 本期彙整3則航空短訊，各則為獨立事件。部分內容摘自近期站內報導，原文與來源見文末。

1. 美聯航華盛頓杜勒斯機場（IAD）E航廈啟用，首期設14個登機門
美聯航與大都會華盛頓機場管理局11月10日在華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場啟用全新E航廈，為該機場近20年來首座啟用的同類設施；首期設施43萬5000平方英尺、14個登機門，未來將再增36個登機門。

2. 澳航A321XLR將首度飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉2027年2月上線
澳洲航空將首度以空中巴士A321XLR執飛國際線，布里斯本—馬尼拉航線預定2027年2月1日改由A321XLR執飛，取代A330-200；A321XLR僅197個座位，讓澳航得以每日飛航。

3. 漢莎航空接收首架A350-1000，同時為漢莎集團第700架空中巴士飛機
漢莎航空11月10日在法國圖盧茲接收首架A350-1000，機名「Deutschland」、註冊號D-AIFA，採百年紀念深藍特別塗裝；新機將駐地慕尼黑，12月23日首飛東京羽田。

en.title: Aviation briefs: United Airlines opens new Concourse E at Washington Dulles (IAD) Airport; Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila
en.summary: 3 independent updates: United Airlines opens new Concourse E at Washington Dulles Airport; Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila; Lufthansa takes delivery of its first A350-1000, its 700th Airbus aircraft.
body: 3 independent aviation updates. Includes excerpts of recent reports, with original reports and sources linked below.

1. United Airlines opens new Concourse E at Washington Dulles (IAD) Airport
United Airlines and the Metropolitan Washington Airports Authority opened the new Concourse E at Washington Dulles International Airport on November 10, 2026, the first facility of its type to open there in nearly two decades, with 14 gates in a 435,000-square-foot first stage.

2. Qantas to take Airbus A321XLR international from Brisbane to Manila
Qantas is preparing to take its Airbus A321XLR fleet international for the first time, with Brisbane-Manila services switching from the Airbus A330-200 to the A321XLR on February 1, 2027, allowing the route to operate daily with 197 seats.

3. Lufthansa takes delivery of its first A350-1000, its 700th Airbus aircraft
Lufthansa took delivery of its first Airbus A350-1000 in Toulouse on November 10, 2026. Named "Deutschland" and registered D-AIFA, the jet wears a dark blue centenary livery and will be based in Munich, entering service to Tokyo Haneda on December 23.
